input: Research local indoor climbing gyms nearby

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the user's location or area determines which gyms are actually 'nearby' and sets the geographic boundary of the research.
Whether this is for the user alone, a group, kids, or beginners vs. experienced climbers changes which gym features matter most (e.g., kids' walls, lead climbing, group classes).
Knowing what climbing disciplines matter (bouldering, top-rope, lead, auto-belay) determines which gym attributes to research and compare.
Budget affects whether day passes, memberships, or gear rental costs are a deciding factor in the recommendation.
How far the user is willing to travel defines the practical radius for the search and filters out gyms that are too far.
Understanding what 'done well' looks like — a shortlist, a single top pick, a comparison table — shapes the format and depth of the output.
Knowing what the user values most (community vibe, route variety, coaching availability, amenities) helps prioritise and rank gyms beyond just basic facts.

gold.taskTitle: Research local indoor climbing gyms nearby
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate indoor climbing gyms in the user's local area to determine the best option(s) for their needs.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the search centre on?
questions.description: Identify the user's location or a specific area to anchor the geographic search for nearby gyms.

questions.title: Who is this climbing experience for?
questions.description: Determine whether this is for the user alone, a group, children, beginners, or experienced climbers, as this affects which gym features are relevant.

questions.title: Which climbing styles are you interested in?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants bouldering, top-rope, lead climbing, auto-belay, or a mix, to filter gyms by the disciplines they offer.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to a gym?
questions.description: Establish a maximum travel distance or commute time to define the practical search radius.

questions.title: What is your budget for visits or membership?
questions.description: Understand whether cost is a key filter — day pass affordability, monthly membership range, or gear rental fees.

questions.title: What do you value most when choosing a gym?
questions.description: Identify the user's top priorities such as route variety, coaching, community atmosphere, or facilities like showers and a weights area.

questions.title: What should the final output of this research look like?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a ranked shortlist, a comparison table, a single top recommendation, or just raw notes to review themselves.
